claim: For connected finite simple undirected graphs of order \(n\ge2\), use adjacency-eigenvector centrality and standard PageRank with uniform teleportation and follow-link damping parameter \(\alpha\in(0,1)\). For every graph with \(n\le5\) and every \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), if both centralities have unique maximizing vertices, those maximizers coincide. This is sharp at \(n=6\). Let \(G\) have edges \(\{01,02,03,34,35,45\}\): vertices \(3,4,5\) form a triangle, vertex \(0\) is joined to \(3\), and \(1,2\) are leaves at \(0\). Adjacency-eigenvector centrality has unique maximizer \(3\), whereas PageRank has unique maximizer \(0\) for every \(\alpha\in(0,1)\). If \(p_i(\alpha)\) denotes PageRank, then \(p_0-p_1=2\alpha(\alpha^2+\alpha-3)/[(\alpha+3)(4\alpha^2-\alpha-6)]\), \(p_0-p_3=3\alpha(\alpha-1)/[(\alpha+3)(4\alpha^2-\alpha-6)]\), and \(p_0-p_4=\alpha(4\alpha^2+3\alpha-9)/[2(\alpha+3)(4\alpha^2-\alpha-6)]\), with \(p_1=p_2\) and \(p_4=p_5\); all three displayed differences are positive on \((0,1)\). The lower bound is exhaustive over all connected graph isomorphism classes through five vertices and over the entire damping interval, using exact rational functions of \(\alpha\) and exact Perron-root comparisons.
integrity: The lower bound is exhaustive over all connected graph isomorphism classes through five vertices and over the continuum \(\alpha\in(0,1)\): PageRank coordinates are exact rational functions whose crossing roots are isolated exactly, while Perron-vector maximizers are compared through exact principal cofactors. The six-vertex witness is proved symbolically and independently replayed by the embedded verifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns connected finite simple undirected graphs, ordinary adjacency-eigenvector centrality, uniform-teleportation PageRank, and unique top vertices. It does not classify full rankings, directed networks, or personalized PageRank. The damping interval is exactly \(\alpha\in(0,1)\).
title: Six vertices are the sharp all-damping PageRank–eigenvector-centrality maximizer boundary
